sections.h2: Ibuprofen's China dependence fell sharply with no PLI scheme behind it

chart.title: Ibuprofen's China import dependence fell from 99.34% to 80.73% in one year
chart.sub: China import dependency for ibuprofen, %, by fiscal year.
chart.source: PIB Annexure PRID 2237414 (10 Mar 2026), as reported in this post.

sections.means: Ibuprofen is the one checked molecule where dependence fell by a large margin without a Bulk Drugs PLI project.
